newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Limited upside seen for Singapore stock market.
newsitem.headline: Limited upside seen for Singapore stock market.

text.p: Any upside in the Singapore stock market looked limited and short-lived as the market continued to suffer from thin interest, dealers said on Friday.
Poor interim corporate results by some companies would also weigh on sentiment, they said.
One dealer said the key Straits Times Industrial Index might be battered further if there is heavy selling of index-linked soft-drink company Fraser & Neaves ahead of its results.
F&N is expected to announce its results for six months ended March 31, 1997 after the market closes on Friday.
According to the Edinburgh Financial Publishing's Estimate Directory, the group's profit for year ending September 30, 1997 would be at S$175 million, down 20 percent from 1996.
The Straits Times Industrials Index ended 2.81 points lower at 1,990.68 on Thursday while Wall Street ended 135.64 points up at 7,711.47.
